For every value of `emp.dept_id` (employees without a department form their own group) return `dept_id`, the number of employees `n`, the salary sum `total` and the average salary `mean`.

Tables: `dept(id, name)` and `emp(id, name, dept_id, salary, mgr_id)`. Write a single `SELECT`.
